summary: Truman Michelson was an Indologist and linguist who studied at Harvard, Leipzig, Bonn, and Columbia under Franz Boas. He worked at Harvard, the University of Missouri, the Bureau of American Ethnology, George Washington University, and the Smithsonian Institution.
Trung Huynh is a scholar in Buddhist and religious studies who earned a PhD at the University of the West under the supervision of Darui Long.

Trungram Gyaltrul Rinpoche, active in Buddhist studies and Tibetology, studied at Karma Shri Nalanda Institute and earned a PhD from Harvard under Leonard van der Kuijp, Thomas Burke, and Khenchen Trinley Paljor Rinpoche. He founded two Buddhist organizations.

Active in Buddhist studies and Tibetology, Trungram Gyalwa Rinpoche studied at Karma Shri Nalanda Institute, Sampurnanand Sanskrit University, and Harvard. He held visiting positions at the University of Michigan and McGill University.

Tryambak Shankar Shejwalkar was an Indology and history scholar who studied at the University of Mumbai and served on the faculty at Deccan College Post-Graduate and Research Institute from around 1939 to 1955.

Tryambakarama Sastri, an Indology and philosophy scholar, studied under Lakshmana Sastri Dravida at Government Sanskrit College, Varanasi. He served as head of Government Sanskrit Pathashala in Jamnagar.
Tré Khen Zur Lozang Wangchuk studied under the 13th Dalai Lama, Trijang Rinpoche, and the 14th Dalai Lama.
Trịnh Xuân Thuận is a religious studies scholar who studied at the California Institute of Technology, Princeton University, and the University of Virginia, where he also held a post around 1976.

Tse-fu Kuan is a Buddhist studies scholar who completed a doctorate at the University of Oxford under Richard Gombrich. He held postdoctoral research posts at National Cheng Kung University and Yuan Ze University.

Tsenshab Serkong Rinpoche was a Buddhist studies and Tibetology scholar who earned a Geshe Lharampa degree at Ganden Monastery. He served at Ganden Jangtse Monastery and taught the 14th Dalai Lama and Alexander Berzin.

Tsering Dhundup Gonkatsang is a Tibetologist and linguist who studied at Panjab University, Tibetan Children's Village, and the University of Glasgow. He served as headmaster at Tibetan Children's Village and taught Tibetan at the University of Oxford.
Tsering Gyaltsen is a scholar of Tibetology and Buddhist studies who studied at Sampurnanand Sanskrit University and under Dudjom Rinpoche.

Tsering Shakya, a historian and Tibetologist, earned his BA, MPhil, and PhD from SOAS University of London, where he also served as a research fellow. He later held posts at the University of Oxford and the University of British Columbia.
Tsewang Gyurme is a scholar in Tibetology and history who served as president of the Tibet Academy of Social Sciences and the Tibetan Association for Sacred Studies.

Tsikey Chokling Rinpoche was a scholar in Buddhist studies and Tibetology who studied at the Young Lamas Home School. He held posts at Ka-Nying Shedrub Ling and served on the board of Rangjung Yeshe Shenpen.

Tsoknyi Rinpoche is a Buddhist studies and Tibetology teacher who studied at Khampagar Monastery and under several masters including Dilgo Khyentse Rinpoche. He founded the Pundarika Foundation and held a post at Tergar Osel Ling Monastery.

Tsu-lin Mei was a linguist and sinologist who studied at Oberlin College, Harvard University, and Yale University. He held academic posts at Harvard University (circa 1964–1971) and Cornell University (circa 1971–2001).

Tsuguhito Takeuchi was a linguist and Tibetologist who studied at Kyoto University, the University of Pennsylvania, and Indiana University Bloomington under Christopher I. Beckwith. He served as Professor of Linguistics at Kobe City University of Foreign Studies.

Tsugunari Kubo was an Indology and Buddhist studies scholar who studied at the University of Tokyo and Rissho University. He served as president of Reiyukai and the International Institute for Buddhist Studies, and taught at Rissho University.
Tsui Lan Liza Cheung is a Buddhist studies scholar who completed her PhD at the University of Hong Kong under the supervision of K. L. Dhammajoti, having also studied under Toshiichi Endo.
